# uni_links provenance

Source: https://github.com/rustdesk-org/uni_links/tree/f416118d843a7e9ed117c7bb7bdc2deda5a9e86f/uni_links

Version: 0.5.1. The package runtime/build files and upstream MIT license are retained. Examples, editor metadata and upstream documentation are omitted.

Local patch: remove only the obsolete Android v1 `registerWith(PluginRegistry.Registrar)` entry point, because current Flutter has removed Registrar. Android v2 engine/activity registration, initial/new-intent handling, method/event channels, Dart API and iOS sources are unchanged.
